a11y.apg: No APG pattern: the container is role="log" with aria-live="polite", so lines added after mount are announced as they arrive and the ones already there are not re-read. Nothing is focusable: a log is read, not operated.

props.name: lines
props.type: Array<{time?: string; level?: string; text: string}>
props.description: The lines. The container is role="log" with aria-live="polite", so lines added after mount are announced as they arrive and the ones already there are not re-read. `level` becomes the .log-<level> class.
